column1: # Desired garage S3 buckets + access keys for nexus.
# Managed by homelab-ops/omarchy/nexus — installed by apply.sh to
# Every one of these was created by hand before 2026-09-22. Declaring them means
# a restored garage metadata directory gets its buckets and keys back, instead of
# every backup timer failing with a 403 that reads like a bad credential.
# Key MATERIAL is not declared here and never will be: the backup scripts mint it
# from garage at run time (local admin socket), so a key rotation cannot silently
# break them. zephyr's rclone remote still holds a static key from before the
# 2026-09-20 rotation and now returns 403 — that is the failure this avoids.
